messages:
Mira: FYI spotted a canary spike: mix-quant rollout (fp8 + int4 kernels) is producing malformed JSON for tool-calls. Small workload, reproducible on canary-02.
Alex: Which image/config?
Mira: redwood/model-mixq:v2 + kernel-autoswitch=on, calib-mode=perlayer. Repro curl below:
Mira: ```
curl -X POST https://canary-02.api/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"{{tool_call_json}}","max_tokens":120}' 
-H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY'
```
Jon: Also seeing 18-24% p95 latency increase on canary after the rollout, and token throughput drop ~12%.
Priya: I profiled GPU traces quickly — KV cache eviction rate jumped after the calibration pass. Snapshot: 
Priya: ```
kv_evicts: 137 -> 492
kv_hits: 4212 -> 3890
kernel_switches/sec: 4.8 -> 22.1
```
BenchmarkBot: Canary summary: hallucination-rate +3.2pp, json-parse-failures +2.9pp, p95 latency +18%.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at step 3 per canary healthcheck.
Alex: Hypothesis: kernel-autoswitch is picking an int4 path for attention/kv that is slightly numerically different after fp8 calibration; that leads to truncated tokens at boundaries for structured outputs. Small numeric drift plus batching ordering -> parser choke.
Mira: Can we force fallback to fp8 for LayerNorm & attention-kv to test? Quick patch idea: tweak kernel selector to prefer fp8 for ops flagged "sensitive_to_scale".
Priya: I pushed branch `perf/hard-fallback-lns` which forces fp8 on LN+KV and keeps int4 for matmul. Deployed to canary-02.
Jon: Early results: p95 back down ~6%, json-parse-failures down to near baseline, throughput slightly lower (~3%).
Alex: Good signal. We should run our eval-suite 10k prompts (structured tool-call set) against both configs and capture token diffs + KL divergence.
Mira: Agreed. I'll open an eval run and assign to eng-ml. Also creating ticket to audit kernel selector heuristics + a safety flag to disable auto-switch for structured-output routes.
Priya: Note: calibration pipeline writes a per-layer scale file. We probably need to incorporate per-route eval thresholds so calibration doesn't change sensitive layers without quality checks.
Mira: Moving this to action items: 1) run A/B 24h with fallback patch (Priya), 2) run 10k structured eval + diff (Alex/Jon), 3) add a gating check in calibration to block scale changes that increase parse-failures (eng-ml). I'll post results in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks — if A/B holds we can add a short-term policy to disable autoswitch for customers with structured outputs until selector is hardened.
Jon: I'll start the KL/token-diff dashboards and share the query.
Mira: Great. Keeping rollout paused for now.
